sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Accepted: the candidate preserves the declared ship-to-calculationCase-to-interpolationPoint ownership paths, places calculationCase-owned operands and result correctly, supplies interpolation coordinates and paired point values for all three points, and enforces strict lower-to-intermediate-to-upper ordering without requiring execution of the complex interpolation formula.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Reject: the shape is only a presence check and does not faithfully encode the linear-interpolation readiness relationship. It must explicitly tie the intermediate interpolation point and its interpolatedLongitudinalDistributionFactor result to the same calculation case and to the declared lower and upper endpoint coordinate/value pairs, including the required envelope/order relationship (without requiring execution of the full formula under COMPLEX_READINESS).
